tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250drag po lha gsum gyi gsol 'debs rdo rje'i me 'od 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ kun bzang 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la gsol ba 'debs// gsang chen bka' yi bsdu ba phyag rdor che// snying rje'i bdag nyid khyung la gsol ba 'debs// padma thod phreng ḍā ki mtsho rgyal ma// bai ro nam snying bcas la gsol ba 'debs// zab gter mnga' bdag bdud 'joms rdo rje rtsal// dran chog tshe dbang nor bur gsol ba 'debs// smin grol chos ston gdul bya skyong mdzad dpal// drin ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// yi dam drag po lha gsum rigs bzhi'i 'khor// bdud 'dul khro bcu'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// zab gter ḍā ki snying thig gdams pa'i chos// bskyed rdzogs byin rlabs ldan la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bstan srung mdzad bdud mgon lcam dral dang*// spu gri mched gsum bcas la gsol ba 'debs// dregs 'dul drag po rta phyag khyung gsum gyi// bla ma lhar bcas rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rang rig gnyug ma'i lha mchog mngon zhal mjal// gzung 'dzin ru tra'i bar chad myur sgrol nas// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam bzhi yis// 'gro kun sdug bsngal ma lus myur 'joms shing*// gegs med byang chub 'bras bu che thob nas// snang ba mtha' yas sku gsung thugs 'grub shog /
ces las smon mchog grub bla ma rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor chos skyong dpal ldan gyis smras pa'o// bkra shis/// /
